headlines.snippet: A 14-year-old boy died and 24 people were injured in a cluster munition explosion during a trip in northern Israel. The victims were students and staff from a middle school. Those injured were evacuated to hospitals, with several in serious condition. The military believes the munition was fired by Hezbollah. An investigation is underway to determine if a student brought the munition into their bag before it exploded. Dozens of educational trips to the north will be rerouted.

New Delhi is attempting to retrieve the body for burial in a dangerous operation at over 8,000 meters.
